name: SKHY Global High-Bandwidth Memory Leadership Valuation
rationale: SK hynix Inc. (SKHY) commands global #1 market share in High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM3e/HBM4) with proprietary MR-MUF packaging and strategic NVIDIA allocation. TTM revenue reached ~$72.5B USD with 44.2% net profit margins. At $160.53 (forward P/E 4.76x), our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $244.45 (+52.3% upside at 7.00% discount rate). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in just 28.4% CAGR, well below consensus ($246.97 mean target). Recommendation: ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 9.0 shares, 4.03% target weight). Accumulate on dips near $143.04, trim Tier 1 at $240.00+.

bear.rationale: Memory cycle matures into severe downcycle after HBM4 ramp; margin compresses to 18% on $145.8B Y5 revenue.
risks: Samsung aggressive HBM4 yields compressing industry ASPs
Cyclical downcycle in standard consumer DRAM and NAND memory

base.rationale: SK Hynix defends #1 global market share in HBM3e/HBM4 packaging with NVIDIA priority allocation; expands to $290.5B revenue at 35% margin.
risks: Geopolitical tensions in East Asian semiconductor supply corridors
Raw silicon wafer supply chain bottlenecks

bull.rationale: SK Hynix commands virtual duopoly in advanced MR-MUF packaging for HBM4/HBM4e; $464.7B revenue at 44% margin justifies AI rerating.
risks: Korean Won FX volatility impacting reported USD earnings
